2577-5686-7084-8345.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-5686-7084-8345.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1722-2034-3583-5708.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1722-2034-3583-5708.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
When the Tentacle dies, Vein Ripper triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Oloro triggers, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2

333-2511-8207.easyPrerequisites: Ferocity of the Hunt attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-2511-8207.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability
Repeat.

6758-7872.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack this turn.
6758-7872.notablePrerequisites: Dawnsire has ten or more charge counters on it.
6758-7872.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. Dawnsire triggers, dealing 100 damage to  Black Panther.
Black Panther triggers, dealing 100 damage to target opponent.

64-2103-7370.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Warden of the Eye.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Warden of the Eye from exile to the battlefield.
When Warden of the Eye enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4089-5241.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4089-5241.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Glasspool Mimic and Sakashima's Student each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Glasspool Mimic trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima's Student trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4089-5241.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1322-4149-4599-4871-6019.description:
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ghoulcaller Gisa ability, creating six 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing a Zombie token and Ghoulcaller Gisa.
When the Zombie and Ghoulcaller Gisa die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve Scourge of Nel Toth.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping Scourge of Nel Toth and four other Zombies, returning Ghoulcaller GIsa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-4350-6972.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Butcher Ghoul
When Butcher Ghoul dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Butcher Ghoul
When Butcher Ghoul dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Butcher Ghoul enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
2438-4350-6972.notes: If Butcher Ghoul starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

372-1170-7495.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce at least {U} exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1170-7495.description:
Cast a copy of All Aboard by paying {U}, targeting Abdel Adrian.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Skycoach Conductor. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Resolve All Aboard, blinking Abdel Adrian. All permanents that were exiled with it will return to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {U}.
Resolve Abdel Adrian, exiling the permanents tapped for mana and creating that many 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Repeat.

with a brain counter on it

2713-3094-4460-4659-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
2713-3094-4460-4659-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {1} due to Zirda and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield as a 3/3 Robot artifact creature.
Repeat from step 2.

141-3497-7302.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
141-3497-7302.description:
Cast Whirlwind Technique by paying its mana cost reduced by Ezzaroot Channeler, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost reduced by Ezzaroot Channeler.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Whirlwind Technique targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve Whirlwind Technique, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {0} due to Ezzaroot Channeler.
Repeat from step 3.

2816-3169-4659-7070.description:
Activate Umbral Mantle by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the creature.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {2}.
When the creature enters, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Myr, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

323-586-1368-1745.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
323-586-1368-1745.description:
Cast Priest of Gix from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {2}{B} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Lord of the Forsaken's first ability by paying {B} and sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Lord of the Forsaken ability, causing you to mill three cards.
Activate Lord of the Forsaken's second ability by paying 1 life, adding {C} that can only be spent to cast spells from your graveyard.
Repeat.

856-2034-2558-6748.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
856-2034-2558-6748.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, which is a Food due to Ragost, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Sword of the Meek trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Sword of the Meek trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-3121-6972.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Marionette Master.
When Marionette Master dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Marionette Master enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1170-1329-1482-5295.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard.
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1482-2829-2866-4986.description:
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

4338-4875-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Conspiracy, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

338-567-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-567-5641.description:
Gain life.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

648-6743.easyPrerequisites: You have not drawn cards using Terrasymbiosis this turn.
648-6743.description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token and then putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to your deck size.
Terrasymbiosis triggers, causing you to draw a card for each +1/+1 counter placed, thus causing you to draw your library.

4050-4681-6132.description:
Cast Karmic Guide by paying {3}{W}{W}.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat form step 2.

997-3602--5.notablePrerequisites: At least one of the two persist creatures does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
997-3602--5.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a persist creature that does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Bhaal trigger.
Resolve the Bhaal trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the remaining persist creature.
Resolve the sacrificed creature's persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Repeat.

228-1742-2577.description:
Activate Skullclamp's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Gravecrawler.
Gravecrawler dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Skullclamp, causing you to draw two cards.
Activate Skirge Familiar twice by discarding two cards, adding {B}{B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1657-2169.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {G}{U}.
Cast Murderous Redcap by paying {2}{B/R}{B/R}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
When Murderous Redcap enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing an amount of damage to itself equal to its power.
Murderous Redcap dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Murderous Redcap's persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Repeat from step 3.

116-2085-4639.notablePrerequisites: Kelpie Guide and Kiora's Follower do not have summoning sickness.
116-2085-4639.description:
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Kelpie Guide triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Kelpie Guide ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Kelpie Guide.
Kiora's Follower triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Kelpie Guide.
Repeat.

2178-4147-4215-5231.easyPrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Hua Tuo.
2178-4147-4215-5231.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional nontoken green creature.
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
2178-4147-4215-5231.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the additional nontoken green creature, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession and Hua Tuo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Hua Tuo trigger from step 2, untapping it.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for the sacrificed creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

413-2178-4147-4215.easyPrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Hua Tuo.
413-2178-4147-4215.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional nontoken green creature.
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
413-2178-4147-4215.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the additional nontoken green creature.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession and Hua Tuo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Hua Tuo trigger from step 2, untapping it.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for the sacrificed creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2281-4549-5006-5147.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability twice by tapping Lurrus and Saffi, adding {G}{W}.
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Lurrus.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Lurrus.
When Lurrus dies, Saffi triggers, returning Lurrus from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Saffi from your graveyard by paying {G}{W}.
Repeat.

1651-3129-3715-5365.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one counter on a permanent you control.
1651-3129-3715-5365.description:
Activate Power Conduit by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, putting two +1/+1 counters on Lonis.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating four Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Clues, untapping Power Conduit.
Repeat.

2050-4222-5386.easyPrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Arbor Elf.
Blighted Burgeoning attached to a Forest you control.
2050-4222-5386.notablePrerequisites: Arbor Elf does not have summoning sickness.
2050-4222-5386.description:
Activate Arbor Elf by tapping it, untapping the enchanted Forest.
Activate the ability granted to the Forest by the Aura, adding {G}.
The triggered ability from the Aura triggers, adding an additional {U}.
Activate the Aura attached to Arbor Elf by paying {U}, untapping Arbor Elf.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite blue mana, you may tap the Forest for other colors instead of blue, adding infinite colored mana.

2178-4227-4410.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
2178-4227-4410.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

31-1068-1654-3394.notablePrerequisites: Weatherlight Compleated has at least six phyresis counters on it.
31-1068-1654-3394.description:
Cast Leveler by paying {5}.
Leveler enters the battlefield, exiling your library.
Cast Lokhust Heavy Destroyer by paying {1}{B}{B}{B}.
Lokhust Heavy Destroyer enters the battlefield, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature, and you to sacrifice Lokhust Heavy Destroyer.
Lokhust Heavy Destroyer dies, triggering Weatherlight Compleated, causing you to put a phyresis counter on Weatherlight Compleated and return Lokhust Heavy Destroyer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.

3011-4847.easyPrerequisites: Heartless Hidetsugu does not have summoning sickness.
3011-4847.description: Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, causing it to deal lethal damage to each opponent with an even life total, nearly lethal damage to each opponent with an odd life total, and damage to you equal to half your life total rounded down.

813-1092-1777.description:
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, adding seven mana in any combination of {B} and/or {R}.
Cast Torrent of Souls by paying {4}{B/R}, returning Scholar of the Ages from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Scholar of the Ages triggers, returning Burnt Offering and Torrent of Souls from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

757-2026-4235.notablePrerequisites: Voyaging Satyr does not have summoning sickness.
757-2026-4235.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by tapping it and paying {U}.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; choose not to pay for it.
Resolve the Magosi ability, putting an eon counter on Magosi and skipping your next turn.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it targeting Magosi.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; choose not to pay for it.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; pay {2} and copy the Magosi ability.
Resolve both copies of the ability, cancelling out your skipped turn and taking an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

1256-2034-4871.description:
Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {2}{G}.
The Saproling dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
